DIAGNOSIS READY: Iron deficiency anemia

The laboratory results showing decreased serum iron, low saturation, low ferritin, and increased TIBC confirm iron deficiency. The digital pain that improves with cold (acrocyanosis) and your fatigue are classic presentations of this condition. Given the definitive lab evidence and characteristic symptoms, we have made a diagnosis.
